original_excerpt: Emergency services continue addressing consequences in several districts.
quote_locator: Telegram post 7127, consolidated update displayed at 00:20 Kyiv summer time on the overnight August 4/5 attack context page.

statement.canonical: The Kyiv mayor's official account stated that emergency services were continuing to address consequences in several districts.

original_excerpt: Nine of fifteen injured people remained in city hospitals.
quote_locator: Telegram post 7134, update displayed at 06:26 Kyiv summer time on the same overnight attack context page.

statement.canonical: The Kyiv mayor's official account stated that nine of fifteen reported injured people remained in city hospitals.
